# CLiteRTLM binary: ours (build `6ddc6b998303`)

iOS arm64 slice of `dist/`. For each component: defined symbols whose (mangled) name contains one of its markers, then mentions in the binary's strings. Defined symbols mean the code is linked in; a name that appears only in strings is a reference (a dlopen name, a setting, a log message), not an implementation. Defined matches can still be open code that only configures or loads a closed part (`GpuArtisanConfig`, the dlopen wrapper for the Metal sampler). The record at the end compares Google's v0.18.0 prebuilt with our build of 2026-10-16.
